close_reason: CABF_ALLOWED_ALGS split into CABF_TLS/SMIME/CS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS; independence test added
description:
CABF_ALLOWED_ALGS is a module-level constant used by web_pki_policy, smime_policy, and code_signing_policy alike. This couples non-CABF profiles (S/MIME, code signing) to CABF's algorithm list rather than their own regime's list.

Each profile should own its algorithm policy explicitly:
- web_pki_policy: CABF BR §7.1.3 algorithm list
- smime_policy: CABF S/MIME BR §7.1.3 algorithm list (currently identical to TLS BR but will diverge)
- code_signing_policy: CABF CSBRs §7.1.3 (currently requires RSA >= 3072, stricter than TLS BR)
- fpki/dod/etsi profiles: their own lists

Mechanically: rename CABF_ALLOWED_ALGS to CABF_TLS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS, define separate constants for each profile, and make it clear in docs where each list comes from. When the Profile trait (PKIX-8c6) exists, algorithm policy should be an associated method on Profile, not a shared constant.
title: pkix-profiles: CABF_ALLOWED_ALGS bleeds into non-CABF profiles
